feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 29 May 2026 7:55pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Friday, 29 May 2026 at 8:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Dry for the rest of the evening and overnight, with moderate south or southwest winds. Minimum temperature tonight 12°C.

Dry tomorrow morning with sunny intervals, although a risk of lower cloud developing around the coasts and on the hills by the end of the morning. Light patchy rain arriving by mid-afternoon, generally petering out later in the evening. Hill fog and mist in the south and east of the island becoming more established during the evening. Light to moderate south or southwest winds will gradually increase, becoming fresh for a time later. Top temperature about 16°C in the north.


##Outlook##

Some light rain/drizzle on Saturday night. Hill fog and mist in the south and east of the island gradually diminishing by Sunday morning, leaving Sunday mainly dry and bright with sunny intervals and moderate to fresh west-southwest breezes; temperature reaching 17°C.
